verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe built-in agents for Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring and for Transaction Monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases for human review, and Starter Plan agent configurations exist. That amounts to real delegation of alert-triage work to in-product AI, but only within fixed workflows rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant interface (chat or ad hoc task delegation), first-party docs detailing agent setup and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent performance.
